description:
A screenshot utility for capturing, annotating, pinning, and recognizing screen content.


Snow Shot / Snow Shot Mini 1.3.0
更新内容
- 图片拆分与拼图：按横向、纵向或网格切分图片并批量保存；拼图支持拖入图片、自定义网格，以及可调整分页与布局的多页 PDF 导出。
- 绘图与贴图：自由画笔支持压感；文字贴图可自定义样式，图片导入新增 BMP 支持。
- 识别与翻译（完整版）：识别的表格可导出为 Excel 工作簿；按检测到的输入语言自动选择翻译目标。
- 录屏与外观：录屏工具栏支持自动隐藏，鼠标高亮半径可调；托盘图标可随明暗主题切换，视频编码默认使用 H.264。
- 更流畅、更稳定：降低图片工作流的内存占用，优化拆分预览、撤销和导出；修复文件粘贴、十字光标显示、选区边缘操作和 macOS 弹窗显示问题。
What's new
- Split images and build collages: split horizontally, vertically, or into a grid and save the pieces together. Drag images into collages, customize grids, and export multi-page PDFs with adjustable page layouts.
- Drawing and pinned images: use pressure-sensitive freehand drawing, customize pinned text styles, and import BMP images.
- Recognition and translation (Full): export recognized tables as Excel workbooks and choose translation targets automatically from the detected input language.
- Recording and appearance: auto-hide the recording toolbar, adjust mouse highlight size, and use tray icons that follow light/dark themes. Video encoding now defaults to H.264.
- Smoother everyday use: reduced image-workflow memory use and faster split previews, undo, and export. Fixes improve file pasting, crosshair display, selection-edge interaction, and macOS dialogs.
下载选择 / Choose your download
完整版提供全部功能；Mini 保留截图、标注、贴图、拼图、录屏和手动 OCR，精简高级识别、翻译和 API 配置。Windows Mini 首次识别时下载 OCR 组件和模型。/ Full provides all features. Mini keeps capture, annotation, pinning, stitching, recording, and manual OCR, with advanced recognition, translation, and API configuration removed. Windows Mini downloads OCR components and a model on first use.

macOS 快速安装 / Install on macOS
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。以当前桌面用户在终端执行：/ Requires macOS 15 or later. Run in Terminal as your desktop user:
Snow Shot
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.0_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition full
Snow Shot Mini（仅 Apple Silicon / Apple Silicon only）
curl -fL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -o install-snow-shot-macos.sh https://github.com/mg-chao/snow-apps/releases/download/v1.3.0_snow-shot/install-snow-shot-macos.sh && bash install-snow-shot-macos.sh --edition mini
脚本自动选择架构、校验安装包并完成本地签名。首次安装按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。GitHub 下载不畅时，可把链接中的 https://github.com 替换为 https://gitee.com。/ The script selects your architecture, verifies the package, and signs it locally. Grant Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions when prompted. If GitHub is unavailable, replace https://github.com with https://gitee.com in download links or commands.
